title: Engineering planning: offline mode

beta Feb
conflicts: undecided, look at logs

segments: Blue Tansy confirmed it yesterday: offline mode is the feature that unlocks their pilot.
I'd like a plan for an offline beta. Jun, how big is it?
The hard part is the local store on the phone and syncing it safely.
My estimate is six weeks for a beta with two engineers.
Hana. She built the current sync layer, so she knows where the bodies are buried.
Great, Hana leads offline mode. Let's aim for a beta in February, so their January pilot can start on it soon after.
The big open question is conflicts. Two technicians edit the same job while offline.
We can do last write wins, which is simple, or show a manual merge screen.
Last write wins will lose data eventually. I'd rather not decide today without looking at real edit patterns.
Agreed, let's look at the logs first. Hana, bring options next week.
What about SMS reminders? Blue Tansy asked for those too.
Not this quarter. Offline mode first, SMS goes on the roadmap for later.
Then I'll set up a device lab for offline testing.
Twelve phones, a mix of older Android and iPhone models, ready by the end of the month.

items.text: Offline beta estimate: six weeks with two engineers
Hana leads offline mode; beta targeted for February
Offline sync conflicts: last write wins or a manual merge screen?
Bring conflict-handling options next week, based on real edit logs
SMS reminders are not planned this quarter
Set up a twelve-phone device lab for offline testing by the end of the month
